name: ai-helpers
description: Skills, rules and interface mods for Claude Code: Laravel/Filament conventions, workflow skills, and mods for context tracking, agent-action visibility and deletion guarding.

plugins.name: context-relay
plugins.description: Context weather, prompt-cache warming and one-click handoff of the conversation into a fresh chat: one band above the prompt.

plugins.name: rm-guard
plugins.description: Stops the agent from deleting files without your say-so: reads rm, del, Remove-Item and find -delete through wrappers and asks or refuses.
